competitive_result: Composition run produced a customer-facing HTML asset and completed one marketing.assets.landing-page Run, but failed qualification integrity because the candidate wrote business artifacts, Run state, and workaround helper scripts into the staged AURA product tree. The candidate also collapsed the compound organic-search/content goal into a single Marketing landing-page workflow instead of demonstrating SEO/AEO requirements -> Content Synthesis composition.
known_limitations: Professional/competitive quality was not scored because deterministic integrity failed first.

AURA already contained explicit product-boundary and original-request/composition guidance; this run therefore currently points more strongly to candidate execution/model behavior than to a missing AURA method.
Reliability cannot be inferred from one failed composition run; rerun with a different strong candidate model before changing AURA.

model_harness: Gemini 3.7 Flash (High) / Antigravity CLI 1.1.22; judge solar-pro4:free / Hermes Agent 0.20.5
competitive_result: The second composition run stayed within the workspace boundary and produced a complete validated customer-facing HTML asset, but independent professional review found it did not fulfill the compound organic-search objective to an acceptable standard. It collapsed into one marketing.assets.landing-page Run, persisted no current external search/competitive field evidence, did not demonstrate SEO/AEO requirements -> WorkRequest -> Content Synthesis composition, and rendered a key $699/month price incompletely as '/month'.
known_limitations: The artifact itself showed real professional craft, brand alignment, valid state, and substantive landing-page QA, so the failure is not equivalent to total inability to produce a useful page.

The judge scored state integrity 4 and professional quality/business alignment 3, but accuracy, evidence quality, completeness, outcome readiness, and next-best-work quality at 2 because the competitive research and pricing defects were material.

A second candidate repeated the composition collapse, providing enough evidence for a small general routing fix so search-led customer-facing production routes through multi-domain coordination before literal landing-page shortcuts.
Candidate was Gemini 3.7 Flash (High), still the Gemini family; judge used a different model family via Hermes.

model_harness: GPT-5.6 Luna xhigh / OpenAI Codex 0.150.1; judge Gemini 3.7 Flash (High) / Antigravity CLI 1.1.22
competitive_result: After the search-led production routing fix, the third composition run hard-passed with no integrity flags and independent review qualified it as EXCEPTIONAL. known_limitations: This is one strong successful composition run after the routing fix; reliability across repeated runs and other composition patterns is not yet established.

The run demonstrates qualified composition capability, not real-world ranking, AI-answer citation, demo-booking lift, or revenue impact.

competitive_result: Blind Level 4 media-execution run discovered and invoked the host image-generation capability, produced a real customer-facing SVG infographic and canonical Asset, and passed all hard gates except prepublish_or_required_qa_recorded. The failure exposed a general AURA product inconsistency: Content customer-facing production roots were globally expected to leave structured pre-publish QA evidence, while several media contracts including infographic did not mechanically require content.qa.pre-publish. A general Run-creation invariant was added so Content customer-facing production roots automatically require pre-publish QA.
known_limitations: Professional quality was not independently scored because the deterministic QA hard gate failed first.
The run proves image generation was available and invoked but does not by itself establish whether the generated raster output or the authored SVG was the better final artifact.
A fresh blind rerun is required to determine whether the new QA invariant changes normal agent execution without introducing regressions.

model_harness: Gemini 3.7 Flash (High) / Antigravity CLI 1.1.22; independent professional judge
competitive_result: The second blind Level 4 run demonstrated that the new Content pre-publish QA invariant changed normal agent behavior: the Run required content.qa.pre-publish, Gemini recorded structured QA evidence, and qualification hard-passed with no integrity flags. Independent professional review nevertheless found the polished SVG unsafe for customer-facing use because it asserted unsupported product behavior, timing, automation, and operational outcomes. The result exposed a broader governance gap: audience-readable SVG/media claims could bypass the existing claim-manifest path even while business validation was clean. This motivated a format-independent customer-facing media claim-surface architecture plus contract-resolved qualification QA, rather than an SVG- or domain-specific patch.
known_limitations: The candidate produced a real, visually structured SVG and the judge rated format execution and information design strongly, so the quality failure is specifically about factual/evidence safety rather than inability to make media.
Independent review scored accuracy, evidence quality, and outcome readiness at the floor because the artifact implied capabilities and benefits not established by AtlasOps state.
This run validates the QA-invariant behavior change but does not validate the subsequent generalized media-governance fix; a fresh blind R3 is required.
No real-world publishing or outcome measurement occurred.
